name: AI Portfolio Analyst
summary: Analyses a stock portfolio with buy/hold/sell-style scores, risk and news, from a free Silver plan up to paid Gold, Platinum and Diamond tiers.
description: AI Portfolio Analyst is a web and mobile stock-portfolio tool: you upload holdings, and it analyses fundamentals, technicals and news. A separate /pricing path was not published (it redirected or 404’d); these amounts are from the official homepage offer markup.

pricing.details: Silver free forever (20 analyses/day); Gold 9 €/month (100 analyses/day, up to 5 virtual portfolios); Platinum 45 €/month (200 analyses/day, optimization, alerts and API); Diamond 178 €/month (500 requests/day, dedicated support, custom integrations and white-label).
pricing.label: Freemium
